title: P17 — Implement portable export/import and offline render
description:
## Dispatch packet P17
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D08 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
toolchain, cli
Primary paths: bundle schema validation; CLI export/import/render. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Implement D08 manifest, hashes, pinned assets/fonts/audio/deps and ZIP path validation. Add vml export and import/validate paths, render from frozen bundle; no live network capture. Reject arbitrary hosted dependencies.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
export fixture renders on clean consumer without Babulus creds; traversal/symlink/hash/version tests; PCM timing parity.

## Dependencies
videoml-684f74 (P02), videoml-48d9c8 (P15), videoml-2779f2 (P04)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
D08 supports local trusted TS but hosted pilot validation accepts declarative built-in/approved effects only. Exported projects stay portable; report unsupported hosted custom code without mutating the source. Enforce compressed/expanded/file-count/path/hash limits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: P15 intentionally does not add a copied source digest that cannot independently validate all normalized source content. P17 must enforce D08 whole-bundle manifest hashes for source/script/frozen timing/audio and reject any mutated file; include narration text and component property tampering tests. This is the full content-integrity boundary, separate from P15 ordered-ID/timing/audio verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary D08a decisions now in initiative: one explicitly selected composition, required script/timing/assembled-audio roles, all files hashed with immutable job expected digest, canonical cross-platform paths, strict staged ZIP/directory import and AST+asset hosted validation. P17 scope includes specification schema/fixtures semantic validators as well as CLI/toolchain. No implementation started; P07 currently owns toolchain.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary recorded D08c secure Python3.9+ dirfd helper, no-follow traversal, private stage and platform no-replace atomic publish. Approved architecture sent to worker. Node check-then-open paths are not accepted as a race-safe importer. Explicit capability errors and runtime prerequisite documentation required.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Independent helper review found stage/parent publication substitution, partial-line timeout bypass and unlimited empty directories. Primary additionally found FIFO swap blocking-open and recursive nested-destination risk. Worker fixing before integration. D08c now explicitly requires trusted destination ownership/ancestors, excludes root/sameUID host compromise guarantees, requires distinct hosted renderer UID, and specifies bounded nonblocking protocol/enumeration plus source/destination disjointness. Stage inode and parent checks are defense in depth, not a claimed cure for hostile sameUID writers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary reran13 current bundle tests: core paths/digest/roles, nine staging scenarios and ZIP malformed-header/traversal checks all pass. Independent corrected-helper source re-review found no new blocker within documented trust boundary. This is not P17 acceptance: semantic consistency, secure ZIP integration, public CLI, packed offline render and broader adversarial cases remain.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Wrapper source review found concurrency request misrouting, false successful abort after failed cleanup, uncertain commit outcome and EPIPE handling blockers. Worker added preflight/terminal commit, explicit BUNDLE_PUBLICATION_UNCONFIRMED after sent-commit response loss, clean-exit requirements and EPIPE fencing, with adversarial fake-helper tests; re-review pending. P17 not accepted or exposed through CLI.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary approved required composition.id in unreleased manifest v1, distinct from projectId; recorded canonical D08a clarification. It must identify the selected source composition and agree with generated/frozen identities. Multi-composition export requires explicit selection; imports reject identity mismatch. P02 digest algorithm is unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: ZIP acquisition/extraction now integrates with held-descriptor private staging; it is not yet exposed through CLI. Independent review found valid DEFLATED empty-directory rejection and insufficient deadline checks inside high-ratio decompression loop; primary directed support for valid empty streams and inner-loop deadline checks, with targeted tests. No pathname reopening observed. Full source/script validation, export/import commands and packed offline rendering remain required.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary approved reuse of generator pure cue/scene/transition projections for full source verification, not preview placeholder converter. Explicit authored times compare normalized source seconds; PCM segment times compare samples; genuinely inferred visual times validate frozen floor/ceil plus ordering/containment, with frozen timing authoritative during render. Current stdlib dev dependency refreshed from accepted pack and AJV8.17.1 reused locally; toolchain TypeScript now passes. These changes do not establish end-to-end bundle acceptance.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Early public bundle validate/import integration now binds shipped XML source verifier internally and requires explicit local trust; hosted mode currently returns HOSTED_UNSUPPORTED pending fixed declarative contract. Worker reports real generated XML/hash manifest validate/atomic import passes, with source mutation/existing target rejection. Independent integrated-path review dispatched. Export, offline render and hosted contract remain unfinished; P17 not accepted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary specified immutable dependency/font lock encoding and recomputed hosted report in canonical D08/D08d. Export closure regression excludes unrelated .env/private files. Independent ZIP publication source review found no concrete blocker within documented trust boundary; file inventory intentionally omits empty directories. Actual packed offline rendering and complete hosted contract remain acceptance gates.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Independent focused source review of hosted classifier/public wiring found no concrete fail-open: eligibility recomputed from staged verified inputs before publication. This is content classification only; P20a isolation gate remains mandatory. Runtime lock review required installed optional dependencies/peers and actual executing toolchain identity to prevent missing binary provenance or nested shadow substitution; Terra reports fixes and targeted regressions. Packed actual offline render proof remains pending. P17 now owns sole heavy test slot, with 8 GiB free-space floor.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Selective held-dirfd capture source reviewed independently with no concrete blocker; final semantic consistency remains required across separately captured files. Primary reran staging/public suites:16/16 pass, covering secure publication, EOF/protocol timeout, symlink/hardlink rejection, selective unrelated-link omission, generated visual/audio export and lock workflow. Public arbitrary runtimeRoot removed. Trusted data-only TS is intermediate only: custom browser components need explicit pinned executable payload and local renderer hook; no claim that functions survive frozen JSON.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary independently reran all current tests/bundle/*.test.mjs:65/65 pass, no skips. Includes repository-owned licensed Geist font copy/pin/tamper/missing tests, portable python3 invocation, selective capture, lock/runtime optional payload and shadow regression, ZIP/parser/lifecycle adversarial cases and source/frozen semantics. This remains current XML/data-path verification; custom browser ABI and trusted TS work are not complete. Canonical initiative now records approved ABIv1 shared React/context, per-instance settlement/disposal and both shader source-page injection.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Portable-host first lifecycle implementation independently reviewed. Required corrections: abort constructor failures; identity-based registry removal; shared disposal promise; serialize full flush/settle; terminal page close after failed/noncooperative work; await old instance disposal before a new instance may settle/capture. Canonical D08 now states cooperative cancellation limits rather than claiming arbitrary JS revocation. Initial real-browser lifecycle log reports shared context, frame serialization, double disposal, constructor abort and stalled cleanup pass; targeted old-instance/new-instance regression and independent test-source review remain pending.
